<h2 class="section-title">India National Politics</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Election software controversy:</strong> The Congress party has demanded transparency regarding the ECI’s &quot;ECINET&quot; software, alleging that the commission is withholding information to conceal potential electoral manipulation.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMi-?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I2</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I20</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I21</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Judicial independence debate:</strong> Congress leaders have raised serious concerns regarding the independence of the judiciary under the current government, citing claims from a former Supreme Court judge’s memoir about executive influence on appointments.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I5</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I6</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMi-?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I7</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I8</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I9</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I23</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMixAFBVV95cUxPcjAxX2pjdFFYY3JlQVRQdFJBZGl6UHl6eDBVTlNNRUxvR080MnNZRDExTVUxelcwQU55MUhZY0tYMHp2UVhOWWRCc3Vxd0drZ09mMTd0MDVqM1dHUEk0cjE1Ty1KMlR0M1JBMWRockIyWnBoU1kwR1c5ajd0YldpNDAwTnR1VTZXV3oxNFloSFVWM2lJUVNiYTk5MjdwSWI1U3JOX3NJSGtzbVV1aGkwTTRVTDJVNDJoU0FJSHJZaDZpb1Za?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I24</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Voter rights in elections:</strong> The Supreme Court has ruled that voters can now file criminal complaints against political candidates for submitting false election affidavits without requiring prior approval from the Election Commission.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMimwFBVV95cUxOMUhHTm9IZW5kSHZRcFdhZHNXTy1YakF0VGJkY2pKX3BESDdGeEdYT3dUcHVVTGk0VWhBdHN3U2lKTWpSTmZBbE10TWctRU9qd3JwdmVvaVFIT2hiUkNHRVp1Tnl6dklqa20wbXRfdG51amtxS2t0RHFlYnItZ25fbjJyMnlXMmU1QVF6NkY0ZFdEQU4tVDhXckNVcw?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I10</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMi-?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I11</a></span></li>
</ul>

  <li><strong>Political discourse and conduct:</strong> Tensions between the BJP and Congress have escalated following controversial remarks by Mallikarjun Kharge regarding the Prime Minister’s parents, leading to widespread NDA outrage and demands for an apology.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W13</a></span></li>
